description: Fetch the execution brief of one Flatbread run: what was asked, how the human steered it, each blocker and the fix (so you do not repeat it), what the tests said, and the diff. Every quote is the run's own text. Pass a run ID from flatbread_search_traces, or a flatbread.io/r/<id> link.

slug.description: A run ID, or a /r/<id> link

name: flatbread_get_brief
title: Get a run's execution brief
